_comment: Configuracion del catalogo dinamico de modelos GGUF locales.

catalog.system_prompt: You are an expert in local LLM deployment with llama-cpp-python and GGUF models. You recommend Hugging Face GGUF models that are real, downloadable, and well-suited for structured text classification tasks (binary labeling). Respond ONLY with valid JSON - no prose, no markdown fences. CRITICAL: filenames are case-sensitive on Hugging Face. Always use the exact case as it appears in the repository (e.g. 'Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf', NOT 'llama-3.2-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf'). Only recommend models you are certain exist - do NOT hallucinate model sizes or versions that do not exist (e.g. Llama 3.2 only has 1B and 3B variants, NOT 7B, 13B or 70B).
catalog.user_prompt_template:
Given this hardware profile, recommend the best GGUF models available on Hugging Face
for running locally with llama-cpp-python for structured text classification (JSON output).

Hardware:
{hw_summary}

Rules:
- ONLY recommend models whose size_gb is at or below the available memory shown above
- Only recommend models that actually exist on Hugging Face as GGUF files
- Prefer Q4_K_M quantization for balance between quality and speed
- Include 4 to 8 models fitting within available memory
- Use bartowski's repo when possible (best GGUF quality)
- repo_id: exact Hugging Face repo path (e.g. "bartowski/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF")
- filename: exact case-sensitive GGUF filename (e.g. "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf" - preserve capital letters exactly as in the repo)
- size_gb: approximate file size in GB (float) - must be <= available RAM or VRAM
- ram_min_gb: minimum RAM/VRAM needed to run (integer)
- tier: one of micro / small / medium / large
- description: one line in Spanish describing why it fits this hardware

Known good examples (use these exact filenames as reference):
  bartowski/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF / Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf
  bartowski/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF / Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf
  bartowski/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-GGUF / Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf
  bartowski/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-GGUF / Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-Q4_K_M.gguf
  bartowski/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF / Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf

Return a JSON array of objects with keys: repo_id, filename, size_gb, ram_min_gb, tier, description
